summary: Next-generation e2e testing framework for web and mobile applications built with TypeScript and Playwright, enabling cross-browser and cross-platform test execution.
usecases: Automate end-to-end user flows for web applications across multiple browsers.
Run mobile app UI tests on real devices and emulators as part of CI pipelines.
Generate detailed test reports and visual diffs for regression testing.
ideas: Integrate AI-generated test steps from user stories or acceptance criteria.
Combine with visual regression testing for UI consistency across updates.
Support test parameterization from CSV/JSON data sources for data-driven testing.
